# openmetadata_ai_application (Resource)

Manages an OpenMetadata AI application. An AI application records a deployed assistant, chatbot or copilot together with its development stage and documentation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openmetadata_ai_application" "support_copilot" {
  name              = "support-copilot"
  application_type  = "Copilot"
  development_stage = "Production"
  deployment_url    = "https://copilot.example.com"
  display_name      = "Support Copilot"
  description       = "Copilot that drafts answers to customer support tickets."
  documentation     = "https://docs.example.com/support-copilot"
  source_code       = "https://github.com/example/support-copilot"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_type` (String) Kind of AI application, for example Chatbot or Copilot.
- `name` (String) AI application name. Changing it replaces the application, because the name is also its fully qualified name.

### Optional

- `deployment_url` (String) URL where the application is deployed.
- `description` (String) Markdown description of the application.
- `development_stage` (String) Lifecycle stage of the application, for example Production or Staging. Unset when the server holds no stage.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name shown in the OpenMetadata UI.
- `documentation` (String) Markdown documentation of the application.
- `source_code` (String) URL or reference to the application source code.

### Read-Only

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name. For an AI application this equals name.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID.
terraform import openmetadata_ai_application.support_copilot 1f6a3a52-8d34-4f4b-9d0f-2f1c1c1c1c1c

# Or import by fully qualified name, which for an AI application is its name.
terraform import openmetadata_ai_application.support_copilot support-copilot
```
